race.description: Moama Bowling Club Gunbower Gold Cup
race.comment: The big one of the day has attracted a competitive field that stacks up nicely compared with Gunbower Cups of years gone by. SHAIYHAR (1) should be ready now after two runs back from a spell, the latest when getting within 3-3/4 lengths of Ten Commandments, who is favourite for the last at Flemington on Turnbull Day. Extra 200m here ideal. BLAZING SWORD (3) drifted well back last start before winding up strongly to finish third, beaten 2.5 lengths, over 1600m at Corowa. Look for another barnstorming finish. YAHOO BAR (6) finished fifth when first-up from a spell last start over 1600m at Bendigo after racing on the pace for much of the way. Sure to give a great sight with the benefit of that run. MALE MODEL (7) probably hasn't found the best form of last prep, but has been racing in handy grade and looks suited here. DARTBOARD (8) has been racing consistently of late, finishing third at the past two, and should be ready for a peak performance.
